about_the_game:
Dive into intense combat with Warlanes, a third-person shooter that combines adrenaline-pumping action with strategic depth. In Warlanes, your mission is clear: destroy the enemy's stronghold while safeguarding your own from destruction. Change the flow of battle from a third-person perspective, where every shot, maneuver, and tactical choice counts. Experience the dynamic ebb and flow of a battles limited in size only by the power of your system.

Within each battle, escalation lies at the heart of the Warlanes game mode. Gain experience from your battlefield prowess, leveling up to unlock new devastating abilities and tactical options. Each level up empowers you to tip the scales of battle. Gather resources from strategic locations around the map and invest in your stronghold. Upgrade your base, defenses, troops, and armaments to beat back the enemy forces before they do the same. Every upgrade, every improvement, is a step towards ultimate victory.

Will you rise to the challenge and lead your base to glory, or will the enemy's onslaught prove too overwhelming?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 64-bit 2.5GHz or Faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 (Mobile)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Newer
  • Processor: 64-bit, 3GHz or Faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Experience the fusion of WWII action and strategic MOBA-style gameloop. Lead your troops in third-person shooter battles, guide them down their lanes, and siege the enemy base in a war-torn landscape.
